text: Ship on Friday, and the weekend will review your code more closely than anyone on the team did.
Touch the legacy function nobody owns, and git blame will gladly make it yours.
Your two-day estimate was perfectly honest; it just never said whose two days.
Every merge conflict is two people who were both right, just on different afternoons.
The pager keeps its silence for the one night you finally trust the logs and sleep.
The TODO you leave in tonight's commit will outlive the job you leave next spring.
